notes: Brazilian Portuguese; translated from an English course by Spinnaker Sailing (translator João Carlos), shown with authorisation. Modern yacht (genoa, winches). Lessons: terms, sail trim and manoeuvres, trim adjustments, buoys and safety, right of way, man overboard, knots. Terms differ from European Portuguese: here 'cambar' = tack and 'jaibe' = gybe; the method doc uses 'cambar' = gybe and 'virar de bordo' = tack. In irons = 'filado ao vento' here. Gives 45-50 degrees for tacking (game: about 36). The original link was not reachable from the tool on 2026-11-12; PDF attached.
title: Veleiro.net, Curso de Vela Online (Aprenda a velejar, 7 lessons)
